title: test_messages.py: Duplicate test function name shadows security test (line 144)
description: Lines 95 and 144 both define test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit. Python shadows the first with the second, so the security test at lines 95-106 (marked with SECURITY comment about DoS vector) never runs. pytest only executes the second definition (lines 144-153). Rename one function, e.g., test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit_crafted for lines 95-106.
close_reason: Verified fixed: AST scan of python/tests/{loadng,rpl,announce}/test_messages.py finds zero duplicate function names; the shadowed security coverage now lives as a single test_rreq_hop_limit_range_validated (loadng/test_messages.py:83) which runs and passes.
